scope: Exploratory m1-natural single-source-receiver full three-view PAMF with reference response; source RX 1, source days 1/2/3, six identities. Three fixed arms and three matched seeds 2026092701/02/03. Main split and leo_weak excluded. Prior target results are exposed; this is not independent confirmation.
initialization: Each student continues from the exact same-setting, same-seed source-only original Tri E20, through its own E30 and fixed final E50/11100 updates. Preserve the fixed Tri time permutation and all original mechanisms, cross-day source relation, existing branch-certified physical views and fusion-plus-five-branch same-packet contrast.
controls: matched fusion-plus-branch physical contrast without prototypes
evaluation: Freeze all nine predictions before independent truth-last scoring. Evaluate clean plus six practical scenes on identical physical IDs, DURA-LU primary and DURA-L/raw secondary. Report cross-date separately from combined cross-RX and cross-both, each seed and scene, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions. No test-selected checkpoint, target-based tuning or selective rerun.
success: Seek greater than 2 percentage points over matching PL in clean and each practical DURA-LU scene, and improve over Tri. Report seed and subgroup failures. A single exposed setting cannot establish performance across all settings.
expected_artifacts: Nine real E20 no-query smoke results
Nine fixed E50 source models with source prototype counters
Nine frozen seven-scene predictions then independent truth-last matched seed/scene/subgroup comparisons
